canDoYue: 你識打電話叫外賣、報地址、串街名，同埋問幾耐同送到先畀錢。
canDoEn: Order a takeaway by phone, give an address, spell the street, and ask about the delivery time and paying on delivery.

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: I would like to order a chicken takeaway for delivery to my office, please.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想叫一份雞外賣，送到我辦公室。
dialogue.say: I would like to order a chicken takeaway for delivery to my office, please.

dialogue.speaker: pesi
dialogue.text: What is the full address for this chicken delivery from your shop this afternoon?
dialogue.glossYue: 今下午呢份雞外賣，完整地址係邊？
dialogue.say: What is the full address for this chicken delivery from your shop this afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: The address is eighteen Harbour Street, and I can spell the street name very clearly for you.
dialogue.glossYue: 地址係海港街十八號，我可以清楚串條街名。
dialogue.say: The address is eighteen Harbour Street, and I can spell the street name very clearly for you.

dialogue.speaker: pesi
dialogue.text: Please spell that street name slowly on the phone, one letter at a time.
dialogue.glossYue: 請喺電話慢慢串條街名，一次一個字母。
dialogue.say: Please spell that street name slowly on the phone, one letter at a time.

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: Harbour is H A R B O U R, and the street sits right beside the covered market.
dialogue.glossYue: Harbour 係 H A R B O U R，條街就喺街市旁邊。
dialogue.say: Harbour is H A R B O U R, and the street sits right beside the covered market.

dialogue.speaker: pesi
dialogue.text: The rider will arrive in about twenty minutes from now with your hot chicken takeaway.
dialogue.glossYue: 送遞員大約二十分鐘後送到熱騰騰嘅雞外賣。
dialogue.say: The rider will arrive in about twenty minutes from now with your hot chicken takeaway.

dialogue.speaker: lina
dialogue.text: How can I pay for this chicken delivery when the rider reaches my office later?
dialogue.glossYue: 外賣雞送到辦公室嗰陣，我可以點付款？
dialogue.say: How can I pay for this chicken delivery when the rider reaches my office later?

dialogue.speaker: pesi
dialogue.text: You can pay on delivery in cash when the takeaway reaches your front door.
dialogue.glossYue: 外賣送到門口，你可以畀現金。
dialogue.say: You can pay on delivery in cash when the takeaway reaches your front door.
